issue_context.title: Misleading Minimum Order Size Message in Binance Brokerage
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The minimum order size in Binance is expressed in volume, not quantity.

#### Actual Behavior
We receive the following message:

```
Backtest Handled Error: BrokerageModel declared unable to submit order: [9] Warning - Code: NotSupported - The minimum order size (in quote currency) for GRTUSDT is 10. Order quantity was -46.
```

when abs(-46) x price(GRTUSDT) is less than 10. E.g.  price of GRTUSDT is 0.1, thus 46 x 0.1 = 4.6 < 10. So the message should say:

> Order size was -4.6.

#### Potential Solution
N/A
